name: Gold Atlas Preprocessing Benchmark
description: A benchmarking study and evaluation protocol comparing preprocessing pipelines for multi-structure pelvic MRI segmentation using the Gold Atlas dataset.
general_score_metric: Mean Dice score (mean Dice coefficient across structures)
reputation: A niche medical-imaging benchmarking study referenced by researchers comparing preprocessing pipelines for pelvic MRI segmentation; moderate visibility within that subcommunity but not a widely used general benchmark.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; results sensitive to preprocessing choices and annotation variability; dataset size can be limited for some structures, so results may not generalize broadly.
